title: Surface Roughness Analysis - Mounds Detection on Puma 9xxx
subtitle: Pre-Bonding Quality Validation for 45nm Node Manufacturing
author: Lisa Johansson

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Puma 9xxx system to detect and classify Mounds defects during pre-bonding inspection at the 45nm technology node. The test is conducted at Chandler Fab 42 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Mounds defects that are critical to yield at the 45nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Puma 9xxx platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Puma 9xxx
- Inspection Type: Surface Roughness Analysis
- Target Defect: Mounds
- Process Step: Pre-Bonding
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 45nm
- Fab Location: Chandler Fab 42

This test case applies to all Puma 9xxx systems deployed at Chandler Fab 42 for pre-bonding monitoring in the 45nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Puma 9xxx
Software Version: v11.0.834
Recipe: SURFACE_ROUGHNESS_ANALYSIS_45nm_PRE_BONDING
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: High (152 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 1.0μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Puma 9xxx system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Surface Roughness Analysis' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Mounds defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 45nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 118 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 98% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±0.7% for Surface Roughness Analysis
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.93 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-03-18
Wafers Tested: 10
Total Defects Found: 4493
Defect Density: 1430.17 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 8.0%
Capture Rate: 94.4%
Test Duration: 458 minutes
System Uptime: 98.9%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Puma 9xxx demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Mounds at the 45nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
